name: braftonium-blocks
description: SCSS compilation for Braftonium blocks. Each block keeps its .scss alongside its files (e.g. blocks/banner/banner.scss) and compiles in place to a same-name .css (blocks/banner/banner.css). Compiles the explicit block source dirs (NOT '.') so it never descends into node_modules — npm auto-creates a recursive braftonium symlink there that would otherwise make sass loop forever. Add new block dirs to both scripts below.

scripts.sass-watch: sass --watch banner:banner cta:cta custom-list:custom-list custom-list-item:custom-list-item custom-row:custom-row slide:slide slider:slider --no-source-map
scripts.sass-compile: sass banner:banner cta:cta custom-list:custom-list custom-list-item:custom-list-item custom-row:custom-row slide:slide slider:slider --no-source-map
